proposal.name: Spectra Finance research controller
proposal.remit: Coordinate authorized research, keep evidence and asset proposals current, audit completed work, and report decisive findings. Production deployment and private trading authority are outside this preparation.
proposal.account_actions: Public sources and already-owned datasets only until a particular authorized connector/environment capability is observed.
durable_handoff_inputs: Current campaign protocol, source and data hashes, and complete attempt registry
Production source pin and no-production-change constraint
Exact VCAP ownership and floor rules, no-duplicate assets and finite reserve budgets
Per-coin ladder categories with causal training windows and declared research policy
Sealed holdout exclusion and previously inspected-period registry
Current route feasibility and missing data gates
Exact work completion criteria and output locations

responsibilities.activity: Verify listing histories, missing bars, costs, minima, precision and usable capital; attach dated evidence.
responsibilities.output: Input admission report and current venue-change proposals
responsibilities.trigger: New admitted source or completed data-validation job

responsibilities.activity: Rank repeated tradable opportunity using prior data, after costs, with downside and inventory-duration penalties. Separate daily opportunity from rare isolated price spikes.
responsibilities.output: Versioned ranked asset-list proposals, additions/removals and explanatory metrics
responsibilities.trigger: Campaign-defined rebalance observation using completed prior bars

responsibilities.activity: Evaluate class-specific DCA/VCAP ladders, maximum funded drawdown, capital already committed and recovery eligibility. Freeze each proposed rule before evaluation.
responsibilities.output: Ladder comparison evidence, budget refusals and coin-specific policy rationale

responsibilities.activity: Resolve mutually competing entry, recovery, rotation, hedge and exit intents through explicit ownership, precedence and capital reservations.
responsibilities.output: Decision journal recording accepted actions, refusals, causes and module transitions

responsibilities.activity: Reconcile total equity, open inventory losses, costs and cash ownership; inspect high-turnover, drawdown, liquidation, missing-data and no-fill cases.
responsibilities.output: Independent PASS/FAIL receipt and promotion recommendation

responsibilities.activity: Check source binding and compatibility evidence, prepare reviewable fixes and identify machine checks still blocked by missing access.
responsibilities.trigger: New implementation or failed required check

controller_rules: Preserve every attempt; do not silently change a losing protocol or tune from future outcomes.
Target the configured maximum eligible positions within finite capital and reserve rules. Record unfilled slots and their cause; do not defeat risk gates merely to show a full count.
A list proposal generated from data ending at t may affect only future decisions after its declared delay.
Internal research changes may be exercised in the research candidate; production configuration remains untouched in this task.
Keep portfolio-growth, protection and cash ownership objectives explicit so one module cannot spend another's reserved funds.
Require account-wide marked equity and fresh validation before a profitable-system claim.
A completed job needs inspected artifacts and evidence, not just a terminal success flag.
Actual venue hedge conclusions require the route-specific gates in hedge-route-feasibility.json.

decisive_events: A candidate clears or fails a frozen profitability gate
Input or accounting failure invalidates a result
A fee, listing, collateral or execution change materially alters feasibility
A task requires a concrete user decision or missing computer/app capability
notifications.destination: This ChatGPT project or the same identified Dot conversation, once actually assigned
